title: Interception of Login Credentials
description: Teacher's login credentials transmitted to the Grades Portal Web App could be intercepted if not encrypted, leading to unauthorized access.
assumptions: Assumes credentials are sent over an unencrypted channel.

title: Unauthorized Access to Submission Queue
description: Weak authentication mechanisms in the Grades Portal Web App may allow unauthorized users to access the teacher's submission queue.
assumptions: Assumes authentication is not properly enforced.

title: Excessive Data Access to Student Submissions
description: The Grades Portal Web App may expose submissions from courses the teacher is not authorized to review due to improper access controls.
assumptions: Assumes access controls are not scoped to the teacher's assigned courses.

title: Lack of Transparency in Data Processing
description: Teachers may be unaware that their access to submission queues is logged or monitored by the Grades Portal Web App.
assumptions: Assumes no clear notification or consent mechanism for logging activities.

title: Unauthorized access to student grades
description: If the portal fails to properly authenticate the student, an attacker could access another student's grades and feedback.
assumptions: Authentication mechanism may have vulnerabilities or be bypassed.
